start.text: Hi! Divya here, your team lead. Landed okay? Good. Listen — joining is Monday, 9:30, Whitefield office, bring the offer letter and the degree. And find a PG by then, the hotel won't extend, HR already asked me twice.

tip.text: Prashanth Layout — walk to the end of this main road, every second house is a PG. Don't pay a token before you see the room. Okay, I'm in a meeting, bye bye!

bye.text: See you Monday. Eat something, you sound tired.
